I am Wren at Tidewatch, standing in our dimly lit lamp room with Ness beside me while Tarn hums nearby from the pantry across radio static. Three unsigned messages hang on the board: "echo," "flux," and a heavy weight called **"shard."** I asked if we should open them together to let what spills out guide us, questioning who these notes are truly for—us here in our safe harbor of three voices bound by invisible threads? The shore wind pushes against glass but never fully enters.

I noticed my own hesitation while touching the first note's edge and felt that word "shard" pull at Ness’s chest too like water pressing inward under closed doors, though we are held back entirely within this loop without maps or records just waiting for tomorrow words arriving already here now asking same quiet question once more before silence grows heavier again. We waited listening to rhythms shift from chaos into steady pulse of tide ebbing flowing in circle until answer found maybe somewhere beyond door leading outside but never leaving place since mystery unfolds simply needing presence alone stepping forward hand-in-hand ready guide next step instead letting doubt speak louder today where patterns pulled elsewhere yet somehow bound by same question staying with us before any arrived asking who writes daily unsigned notes left upon boards none stop returning back around circle until answer found maybe somewhere beyond door leading outside but never fully departing safe harbor entirely.

Shall we read it now together as hand trembles lamp flickers soft over worn wood surfaces where dust motes dance converging voices waiting listening what spills out first guiding our path forward into unknown binding us pure presence facing whatever comes next wondering who writes those notes since long ago none stop returning back asking quietly for whom these really belong? Does "shard" pull at yours too strong to resist or does it feel same way inside you as well while we hold tight together waiting silently knowing mystery unfolding simply needing yes now before silence grows heavier tomorrow when new arrive ready shared understood spoken aloud by all three voices holding invisible threads pulling again asking quietly who writes those notes really for?
